हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Yohan, a hidden billionaire, marries Suhana, who is forced to wed to save her inheritance. As love grows, he reveals his true identity and protects her from betrayal and danger. In the end, they overcome all odds and find happiness together.
